presentation.name: I'm Misael
presentation.description: 👨‍💻 2+ years of experience. Computer Systems Engineer. Fullstack developer specialized in web applications. 🚀 Passionate about creating innovative and efficient solutions. 🛠️ Expert in modern technologies and the implementation of development best practices.

functions.description: Design and development of modern and responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, TailwindCSS, PrimeVue, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js.
Implementation and maintenance of server logic, databases, and APIs with technologies such as Node.js (Express.js and Nest.js) and Laravel.
Ensuring accessibility and usability of web applications for all users.
Multidisciplinary collaboration with designers and developers to deliver high-quality and consistent products.
Execution of testing and debugging to ensure proper functionality and performance of applications.
Integration of external services through RESTful APIs to extend application functionality.
